## Safety checklist

- [ ] Provider access remains read-only.
- [ ] Raw-record requests are bounded and raw arrays are discarded after normalization.
- [ ] Fixtures, screenshots, logs, and exports use synthetic or reviewed data.
- [ ] Generated policies remain visible, export-only drafts.
- [ ] Tests cover behavior and failure boundaries.
- [ ] Public documentation reflects setup, behavior, and limitations.
